To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
HCMV infection induces the differential expression of 2,153 protein-coding genes and 1.070 lncRNAs in THP- 1 cells.
HCMV infection can alter the expression of a number of mRNAs, lncRNAs in host THP-1 cell.
HCMV latent infected THP- 1 cells can induce a series of transcriptional changes of mRNAs, lncRNAs, miRNAs and circRNAs.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the identification and analysis of host gene expression changes during latent HCMV infection and will be a useful resource for future studies of HCMV pathogenesis and host-virus interactions.
the identification of host genes and lncRNA expression profiles in THP- 1 cells during HCMV latency and will be helpful in understanding the pathogenesis and treatment of viral infection.
the molecular mechanisms of host-virus interactions and provides an insight into the pathogenesis of HCMV.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the RNA-seq is an efficient method to identify the DE genes and lncRNA in THP- 1 cells during HCMV infection.
the host-viral interaction is a dynamic process, and the transcriptional changes in host cells are a reflection of the complex interactions between the virus and the host.
the RNA-seq data presented here will be useful for further investigation on HCMV infection.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
HCMV infection induces a wide range of host gene expression changes in THP- cells and the majority of DEGs and lncRNas were involved in pathways associated with viral infection.
the transcriptome of THP-1 is altered by HCMV infection.

the transcriptome altered by latent HCMV infection in THP- 1 cells was characterized by RNA-seq, which would be a useful resource to understand the host-virus interplay and to develop therapeutic strategies for the control of HCMV disease.
The main takeaway from our work is that
RNA-seq is a useful method for the study of HCMV infection and that the transcriptomic changes during HCM-V latent infection are complex and may be associated with the host immune response.
RNA-seq can be a useful tool for the identification of DEGs and lncRNAS associated with viral infection.
RNA-seq is a powerful tool to study the host-virus interactions and to identify the key genes and lncRNA involved in viral pathogenesis.
